Factor \(7632=2^4\cdot 3^2\cdot 53\).

The possible two-digit factors paired with a three-digit factor are:
\[
12\cdot 636,\ 16\cdot 477,\ 18\cdot 424,\ 24\cdot 318,\ 36\cdot 212,\ 48\cdot 159,\ 53\cdot 144,\ 72\cdot 106.
\]

Since the product \(7632\) uses digits \(7,6,3,2\), the remaining digits in \(abc\) and \(de\) must be \(1,4,5,8,9\) exactly once.

Only
\[
159 \times 48 = 7632
\]
uses \(1,5,9,4,8\) exactly once.

Thus \(abc=159\), so \(b=5\).

\[
\boxed{5}
\]
